property_mix.notable: Spa town with significant Victorian/Edwardian villas; substantial post-1945 suburban growth around core.

locksmith_relevant: Victorian villas and Edwardian terraces dominate central Milverton; period locks and sash windows require specialist knowledge.
Post-war suburbs (Lillington, Sydenham) feature standard mortice and lever locks; high domestic call volume for routine access.
Modern developments like Myton Park increasingly demand smart locks and multi-point systems; locksmith upskilling essential for market share.
